name: Hurting The One You Love
overview: Scripture calls believers to love even those who may wrong them, urging us to bless and pray for our enemies rather than repay hatred with hatred, reflecting Christ's command to love beyond natural inclinations (Matthew 5:44). Genuine love is marked by humility and sincerity, not by seeking human approval in religious acts (Matthew 6:5). Forgiveness is essential, as God promises to forgive those who forgive others, underscoring the importance of mercy in relationships (Matthew 6:14; Luke 6:37). Treating others as we would want to be treated fosters grace and reconciliation, trusting in God's power to work in all situations (Luke 6:31; Luke 1:37).
